item.description: breaking / deprecated wording Breaking keyword in a minor release Quote: **`langchain` 1.5.0 drops support for Python 3.10**, which has reached end-of-life. The minimum supported version is now Python 3.11, and the minimum `langchain-core` version is now 1.8.0. Users on Python 3.10 will continue to resolve `langchain` 1.4.x.
